title: Aerial image sheet of a street
subject: Geography
unit: Summer 1: My local area, maps and aerial images (Street Detectives)
source: Seeded from geography/y2 lesson 8 (Aerial image sheet of a street (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 8: Aerial and satellite views of a street; review quiz. To understand how aerial and satellite images show a street from above and how they compare with maps

model.title: Find the park on the image

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Look for a big green patch

parts.label: Answer
parts.text: The green patch is the park

questions.q: On an aerial photo, what colour are trees?
questions.model: Trees have leaves. From above we see the tops of the leaves. They look like green blobs.

questions.q: Which has a key: a map or a satellite image?
Review quiz in the portal: 8 questions on human and physical features, symbols, keys, compass points, then and now, germs and handwashing.
questions.a: Answers on the quiz key; aim for 6 or more
questions.model: Teacher reads question 1 and shows how to choose an answer.

questions.q: On the aerial image sheet, circle a road, a tree and a roof.
Write one thing a satellite image shows that a map does not.
Big question: what can a satellite see that you cannot?
questions.a: The whole street from above: roofs, gardens and roads together
